text:
Chip Fields played Rochelle, one of J.J.'s girlfriends, in "J.J.'s New Career, Part 2" (Season 4, aired November 17, 1976), per [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chip_Fields) and [TVMaze](https://www.tvmaze.com/characters/204646/good-times-rochelle). The team note's claim that Rochelle was also a recurring role as Penny's friend isn't supported by these sources, so I'd disregard it. Her later Good Times role was Lynnetta Gordon, Penny's abusive birth mother, in four episodes.

CONFIDENCE: 85
